lede: Halloween weekend owns the calendar this week — parade, fire station open house, Young Frankenstein on stage, and Easy Jim's two-night run all land Friday through Saturday. On the meetings side, a rescheduled Telluride P&Z session on November 2 takes up a real land-use question: whether to merge two adjoining lots on West Columbia into a single 5,625-square-foot parcel. Most other boards either haven't posted agendas yet or are handling routine business.

notable.stake: P&Z votes on merging two West Telluride lots into one parcel.
